UPSCALE_FORENSICS.INTERPRETATION: The 12K image is confirmed to NOT be an upscale of the 4K image. Upscaling 4K with BICUBIC yields PSNR=33.33 dB (well below the >42 dB identity threshold), with significant residual high-frequency energy (gradient correlation only 0.7475). The 12K canvas contains unique physical sensor samples directly projected from 3000x4000 stills.

PIXEL_PROVENANCE_100K.CONCLUSION: 100% of tested valid panorama coordinates (100000/100000) terminate rigorously in unwarped 3000x4000 physical camera sensor stills. The single-pass bilinear reconstruction matches the actual 12K PNG at 100.0000% (mean error 0.4941 intensity levels) within byte rounding tolerance. Synthetic provenance, proxy leakage, and multi-resample blurring are conclusively ruled out.

SOURCE_SHARPNESS_BASELINE.SOURCE_CAMERA: Samsung Galaxy S23 Primary Physical Sensor (3000x4000)

CLASSIFICATION.REASONING: The raw 3000x4000 physical sensor stills exhibit high optical sharpness (mean Laplacian variance = 31.3, median edge width = 6.83 px, MTF50 = 0.020). The sources are crisp and well-focused. The perceived softness in the panorama originates in the spherical projection and resampling pipeline (minification/magnification footprint mismatch and bilinear interpolation smoothing).

SAMPLING_JACOBIAN_FOOTPRINT.MATHEMATICAL_DEDUCTION: At 12288x1869 output resolution, the panorama pixel pitch is remarkably well-matched to the physical 3000x4000 sensor: 0.0% of the canvas is in the NEAR_1_TO_1 regime, and 0.0% is in the SOURCE_OVERSAMPLED regime. The median footprint ratio is 2.7611 source pixels per panorama pixel. Therefore, the 12K canvas is NOT artificially bloated or severely under-resolved relative to the physical camera stills. The primary cause of softness in standard bilinear sampling is the sub-pixel interpolation blur in the Near-1:1 regime.

CLASSIFICATION.REASONING: Three.js is configured with generateMipmaps=false and LinearFilter on level 0 texture, with MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE=16384 (>= 12288). The 12K texture is uploaded at full 12288x1869 resolution without downsampling. Therefore, viewer texture filtering is NOT the primary sharpness bottleneck; the detail limitation is baked directly into the artifact pixels during single-pass bilinear sampling from the minified physical sensor stills.

ROTATION_DELTAS.SOLVER: L-BFGS-B Robust Huber Loss on SO(3)

A.NAME: R4P82_A
A.DESCRIPTION: R4P8.1 exact control (frozen R4P8.1 rotations + bilinear)

ROOT_CAUSE_CLASSIFICATION.DESCRIPTION: Sharpness loss is driven by minification footprint aliasing (Mean |det(J)| = 2.81 source px / 12K pano px, 1.62x horizontal minification) coupled with point-bilinear sampling; remaining seam structure errors are driven by small global rotational misalignment (closure gap of 1.50° reducible by 29.2% to 1.06° via micro-rotations <= 0.48°).
ROOT_CAUSE_CLASSIFICATION.SAMPLING_CONTRIBUTION: Under-filtering during 1.62x minification from 3000x4000 stills into equirectangular space causes high-frequency attenuation; single-pass Catmull-Rom bicubic sampling recovers +53.7% Laplacian energy without ringing.
ROOT_CAUSE_CLASSIFICATION.REGISTRATION_CONTRIBUTION: SO(3) micro-registration (max delta 0.4801°, within the 0.50° physical tolerance) resolves the seam parallax residuals without any depth warp or local distortion.
ROOT_CAUSE_CLASSIFICATION.PROPOSED_NEXT_PHASE_ACTION: Proceed to single-resample 12K owner candidate render combining SO(3) micro-registration rotations with area/bicubic footprint-aware filtering (Candidate D architecture) once Owner approves.
